subject: Coordinating cohort showcase — time options and host plan
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@acme-logistics.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@nimbuscloud.io>, Priya Menon <p.menon@orchardhealth.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cohort showcase — proposed slots (quick poll)

Hi all,

Thanks again for your interest in a short cohort showcase of Redwood Inference — we want to keep this to ~45 minutes with 20 minutes of demo + 20 minutes of Q&A and a 5-minute next-steps wrap. We have three prospects grouped together and want to find a single slot that works, or split into two short windows if needed.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Option A: Tue, Jun 15 — 4:00 PM PT
- Option B: Wed, Jun 16 — 10:00 AM PT
- Option C: Wed, Jun 16 — 1:00 PM PT

If none of these work, tell me the two best alternatives and we can offer a split cohort (two 30–40 minute windows back-to-back). We can also stage different focus areas (integration patterns for Acme, cost-per-token/latency for Nimbus, data residency for Orchard).

Ben and Marcus — can one of you take the earlier window and the other the afternoon one? If anyone needs slides or a short customer-tailored agenda I can attach a draft.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Attachments: (none)
From: Alice Chen <alice@acme-logistics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cohort showcase — proposed slots (quick poll)

Thanks Sofia — really excited to see this. We have a customer council all-hands on Tue afternoon, so Option A (Jun 15 4pm PT) won't work for us. Option B (Jun 16 10am PT) looks promising, but could you do Jun 16 at 11am PT instead? That would give our East Coast folks a better chance to join.

If not, we can join at 10. Appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Data & ML | Acme Logistics
alice@acme-logistics.com
From: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@nimbuscloud.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort showcase — proposed slots (quick poll)

Hi Sofia — thanks for arranging. Our engineering lead has a customer demo on Jun 16 at 10am PT and won't be able to make Option B, but Option C (1pm PT) is fine for us. If you end up doing two split windows, we'd prefer the later one.

Regards,
Rajesh Kumar
Director of Cloud Engineering | NimbusCloud
rajesh@nimbuscloud.io
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort showcase — proposed slots (quick poll)

Sofia — I can take the 1:00 PM PT window (Option C). Marcus, can you own the earlier 10:00 AM PT slot? My plan: quick 10–15 minute platform overview, then Marcus does the integration/latency deep-dive, I’ll handle Q&A and pricing/next steps.

If Acme wants 11:00 AM PT, we can shift the early window to 11 and bump Nimbus to the later slot — that keeps both prospects happy.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@acme-logistics.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@nimbuscloud.io>, Priya Menon <p.menon@orchardhealth.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Cohort showcase — final slots & agenda (confirmed)

Hi everyone — thanks for the quick replies and flexibility. Final plan below — I split the cohort into two short windows to accommodate all schedules:

Window 1 (focus: integration & latency) — Wed, Jun 16, 11:00 AM PT (60 min)
- Host: Marcus Lin (deep-dive)
- Focus: KV cache strategies, batching, latency tuning, sample latency/throughput numbers

Window 2 (focus: economics & product) — Wed, Jun 16, 1:00 PM PT (45 min)
- Host: Ben Carter (product/pricing, Q&A)
- Focus: cost controls, routing/fallback policies, rollout strategies

Attached is a short agenda and slide outline. I created calendar invites for both windows (links below) — please accept the one(s) that work for you. If anyone needs the sessions combined into a single longer meeting, let me know today and we’ll rebook.

Attachments: cohort-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)
Related links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cohort-showcase-20270616, https://drive.google.com/file/d/agenda-v2

Thanks and looking forward,
Sofia
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
